scientific_question: Can a causal, observation-fitted three-dimensional affine transport of the previous deployed reconstruction preserve sparse-view gradients that static global quadratics and coefficient persistence failed to preserve?
role: post-open private controlled virtual-BOST mechanism diagnostic; not real experimental pairing, not a learned method, and not a deployment or resource result
physical_hypothesis: The remaining sparse-view gradient tail may be caused by coordinate motion rather than coefficient persistence. A small invertible affine flow fitted only to the current observation innovation should transport inherited edges before the unchanged current-observation H1 solve.

new_data_boundary.senior_instruction: generate two-component 2D displacement fields from the executable 3D density field and camera positions
new_data_boundary.historical_pairing_status: the old real 2D-to-3D correspondence is unavailable and is not inferred
new_data_boundary.claim_boundary: all v164 observations are simulated by the frozen straight-ray BOS proxy; real_bost remains false

frozen_predecessor.closed_family: one-sided persistence of the previous deployed DCT coefficient vector under an L2 innovation penalty

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is the reconstructed density field; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and two-component observations are generated by code for the controlled virtual proxy; no true experiment pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior, frozen before v164 results

inputs.models: the same nine CPU-adapted TorchScript models sealed by v157-v163
inputs.calibrations: the same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v163

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean orthonormal DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.initial_anchor: at t=0 use the frozen isotropic H1 fixed-0.03 reconstruction because no previous deployed state exists
representation.affine_generator: u(x)=h_min*(v+M*s(x)), where s maps each world axis affinely to [-1,1], v has three entries, M has nine row-major entries, and h_min is the minimum field-grid spacing
representation.observation_fit: form twelve infinitesimal transported-density tangent fields -grad(rho_previous) dot du_k, project each through the current reported-geometry operator, and solve the current observation innovation by column-normalized minimum-norm SVD
representation.exact_transport: scale the fitted generator only when necessary, exponentiate its centered 4x4 homogeneous matrix, inverse-map the current grid, and use trilinear interpolation with zero outside the frozen box
representation.maximum_corner_displacement: h_min*(t_i-t_(i-1))/0.25; one minimum-grid cell per reference time step
representation.trust_region_scaling: if the exact exponentiated corner displacement exceeds the cap, use 60-step monotone bisection on one scalar in [0,1]; no component clipping or refit
representation.current_solve: project the transported prior into the same DCT subspace and solve (G+alpha*H)c=q+alpha*H*c_transport with the frozen isotropic H1 penalty and alpha=0.03*median_positive_generalized_eigenvalue
representation.no_transport_control: the same causal centered-H1 recurrence using the previous control coefficients directly, with no affine fit or warp
representation.previous_state: the immediately previous reconstruction of the same arm, model, calibration, and active-camera set; never truth or a separately selected candidate
representation.permutation_contract: camera-row reordering leaves G, q, fitted affine parameters, transported prior, and reconstructed coefficient unchanged within frozen numerical tolerances
representation.variable_cardinality: the same mechanism is rebuilt independently for the fixed 5-, 7-, and 9-camera active sets
representation.forbidden_variants: no future frame, bidirectional smoothing, truth state, reset, fallback, coefficient clipping, generator component clipping, post-result radius, alternative SVD cutoff, non-affine warp, learned transition, alternative anchor, per-sample selector, or post-result multiplier

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count
affine SVD rank, condition, linearized residual ratio, cap activity, exact corner displacement, determinant, centered-H1 stationarity, and camera-permutation difference

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration; all camera subsets, models, times, and arms reuse sealed geometry
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one exact A-transpose equivalent for current q, twelve exact current-geometry forward actions on affine tangent fields, and one exact A equivalent for the final current projection
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.physics: rebuild camera rays and sparse operators with the independent v156 numerical path

independent_recomputation.affine_fit: rebuild the twelve tangent fields, use an independent SVD path, independently exponentiate the homogeneous generator, and use a separately coded trilinear interpolator
independent_recomputation.solver: use independent generalized eigendecomposition and direct spectral centered-H1 reconstruction; do not import formal transport or centered-solver helpers
independent_recomputation.sequence: rebuild every model-calibration-camera sequence in ordered time using only independently generated observations and the prior independent arm state
required_comparisons: all 1404 formal and independent primary coefficient vectors
all 1404 affine parameter vectors and transported-prior coefficient vectors
frozen v163 H1 and CGLS rows and summaries

decision_order: Any input, source-semantics, operator, basis, sequence, density, affine-rank, linearized-fit, diffeomorphism, cap, stationarity, residual, accounting, historical-control, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v164 inconclusive.

Only the frozen 12-generator observation-fitted affine transport with fixed cap, SVD cutoff, interpolation, H1 multiplier 0.03, and causal recurrence is primary; no alternative warp or radius may replace it after results.

The primary passes only if every one of the twelve time-by-camera strata passes all absolute gates, each nine-camera stratum satisfies parent no-harm, and the formerly failed t=0.75 five-camera gradient p90 is strictly lower than the frozen H1 value.
If the no-transport centered-H1 control also passes all twelve strata, affine transport is not credited as the explanation and a predictor is not authorized from this diagnostic alone.
A valid primary failure closes the current global affine-transport reference mechanism and does not authorize warp tuning, a non-affine model, a larger network, or GPU rescue.

A valid primary pass with no-transport-control failure establishes only controlled virtual-BOST coordinate-transport headroom and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU observation-only predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
